data.long_meaning: From the Persian word ‘Emar’, meaning ‘Imperial, Commander, King’. In Hindu mythology, Imarana is the name of a celestial being, the commander of the army of the god Indra. This name is believed to bestow courage, leadership, and strength upon the bearer. The name इमरान carries the meaning “Imperial, Commander, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose इमरान usually hope their child will grow to embody imperial, commander, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Imran is considered to be a powerful and spiritual name in Hinduism. It is believed to bring strength, courage and protection to the bearer. It is also associated with the Hindu god Indra, who is known as the god of thunder and war. Imran is said to be a name that is bestowed upon those who are destined to lead and protect.
